# bar-wall-evidence.txt — each node's whole-bar wall time, TRACKED so the bar's cost is evidence.

# node's next --record: the LATEST reading, not a maximum, because a wall time measures a bar and
# bounds nothing. A record taken with --scoped is refused: a guarded run is not the whole bar.
